evals.name: enable-mcp
evals.prompt: Host Library MCP tools with catalog as their scope prefix.
evals.expected_output: Configure capabilities, MCP and the endpoint.
assertions: Calls WithCapabilities and WithMcp on the Arc builder.
Configures ApplicationName as catalog and maps MapArcMcp.
Identifies catalog:read and catalog:write on the capabilities listener.

evals.name: register-author-tool
evals.prompt: Expose the existing RegisterAuthor command to verified MCP clients.
assertions: Places ExposeOverMcp on the command record.
Uses a valid name and nonempty description.
Preserves its AuthorId and event-returning Handle.

evals.name: list-author-tool
evals.prompt: Expose a finite author list and verify a caller without read scope gets no author names.
evals.expected_output: A finite query tool with call-time scope checks.
assertions: Annotates a static read model method, not the observable subscription.
Returns rows from the typed collection.
Checks both tool visibility and direct call refusal.
